title: HYDRAULIC STEERING-CONTENTS
summary: Contents of the N40 option section (hydraulic power steering): pump, bracket and hoses (A2), power cylinder and bracket (A3), control valve and hoses (A4), pump pulley and bleeding (A5), pump mounting and generator mounting for the 454 engine (A6, A7), and belts and pulleys (A8). A note for the 454 engine says to rotate the radiator inlet hose inboard and forward until it touches the fan shroud.
notes: NOTE Rotate radiator inlet hose inboard & fwd to a point where it comes in contact with rad. fan shroud. (VIEW A, 454 ENGINE)
